versions.content: The function NvM_SetBlockLockStatu s shall only work on NVRAM blocks with a permanently configured RAM block or on NVRAM blocks configured to support explicit synchronization and shall have no effect to other NVRAM blocks. Hint: This function is to be used mainly by DCM, but it can also be used by complex device drivers. The function is not included in the ServicePort interface.
